fixes.summary: harvest_block's level gate read harvest tools before Forge had filled them (ForgeHooks not yet loaded on a fresh server), so obsidian passed harvestLevel 1
Same cause: iron ore read as toolless and passed the default harvestLevel 0

DurationParser folded a duration to a constant by evaluating it with a null context; count_blocks answers 0 there, so 'count_blocks(...) > 0 ? 40 : 400' became a fixed 400 and perTick never re-read it
Recipe load errors only reached a file through /okmodular reload (OKCore's json_errors.txt at the config root); every load now writes recipes/errors.txt beside the recipe JSON
